{"candidate_rtl":"module mul_subexpression(\n    input [7:0] multiplicand,\n    input [7:0] multiplier,\n    output [15:0] product\n);\n    assign product = multiplicand * multiplier;\nendmodule","bottleneck":"The original implementation forms eight partial-product rows and evaluates seven serial 16-bit additions, making the final product dependent on a long carry-propagation chain.","rewrite":"Replace the explicit partial-product matrix and serial accumulation chain with a single unsigned multiplication operator, allowing synthesis to infer and balance an optimized multiplier structure.","expected_timing_gain":"Expected reduction in maximum data arrival time from eliminating the serial row-by-row adder chain and enabling arithmetic-specific balancing during synthesis and mapping.","area_or_other_cost":"Expected area at or below the original implementation because redundant intermediate nets and serial accumulator registers are removed; the inferred multiplier may trade some local logic structure for improved timing. No storage or additional I/O is introduced.","functional_boundaries":"Both inputs remain arbitrary unsigned 8-bit values and product remains exactly the 16-bit unsigned multiplication result for every input combination. Module name, ports, widths, signedness, and combinational behavior are preserved."}
